tool.name: Climate to STICS Format
tool.description: daily weather files from ERA5, SAFRAN, DRIAS or AgroClim data
tool.command: python '$__tool_directory__/climate_to_stics_format.py' --source_type '$data_source.source_type' #if $data_source.source_type in ['era5', 'safran']: --input_file '$data_source.input.input_file' #if $data_source.input.input_type == 'tabular': --input_format 'tabular' #if $data_source.input.cell_id_column: --cell_id_column_index $data_source.input.cell_id_column #end if #else: --input_format 'netcdf' --epsg '$data_source.input.epsg' #if $data_source.input.shapefile_zip: --shapefile_zip '$data_source.input.shapefile_zip' #end if #end if --wind_correction_factor $data_source.wind_correction_factor #elif $data_source.source_type == 'drias': --drias_zip '$data_source.drias_zip' --epsg '$data_source.epsg' --shapefile_zip '$data_source.shapefile_zip' --wind_correction_factor $data_source.wind_correction_factor #elif $data_source.source_type == 'agroclim': --input_file #for $station_file in $data_source.input_files: '$station_file' #end for --input_format 'tabular' #else: --input_file '$data_source.input_file' --input_format 'tabular' #if $data_source.cell_id_column: --cell_id_column_index $data_source.cell_id_column #end if --col_date $data_source.col_date --col_tasmax $data_source.col_tasmax --col_tasmin $data_source.col_tasmin --col_rsds $data_source.col_rsds --col_prtot $data_source.col_prtot #if $data_source.col_etp: --col_etp $data_source.col_etp #end if #if $data_source.col_wind: --col_wind $data_source.col_wind #end if #if $data_source.col_hr: --col_hr $data_source.col_hr #end if #if $data_source.col_vapp: --col_vapp $data_source.col_vapp #end if --unit_temp '$data_source.unit_temp' --unit_rsds '$data_source.unit_rsds' --unit_precip '$data_source.unit_precip' --unit_etp '$data_source.unit_etp' --unit_wind '$data_source.unit_wind' --wind_correction_factor $data_source.wind_correction_factor #end if --output_zip '$output_zip' --log_file '$log_output'

param.name: source_type
param.label: Climate data source
param.help: Sets the expected variable names and the unit conversions applied.
param.option: ERA5 (Open-Meteo table or Copernicus CDS NetCDF)
SAFRAN (GeoSAS table, Météo-France SIM2 table or NetCDF grid)
DRIAS-2020 projections (ZIP archive of NetCDF files)
Custom table (select the columns and units)

param.name: input_type
param.label: ERA5 input type
param.option: Table (Open-Meteo daily archive, e.g. ERA5 Daily Extractor output)

expand.variables: date, temperature_2m_max, temperature_2m_min, shortwave_radiation_sum, precipitation_sum, et0_fao_evapotranspiration, wind_speed_10m_mean (km/h), relative_humidity_2m_mean
mx2t, mn2t (K), ssrd (J/m²), tp (m), pev (m), si10 or u10 + v10 (m/s), d2m (K), aggregated at a daily time step

param.name: input_type
param.label: SAFRAN input type
param.option: Table (GeoSAS export or Météo-France SIM2 file)

expand.variables: date, Tmax, Tmin (°C), RR (mm), ETP (mm), Rg (MJ/m²), FF (m/s), HU (%) for GeoSAS; DATE, TSUP_H_Q, TINF_H_Q, PRELIQ_Q, PRENEI_Q, ETP_Q, SSI_Q (J/cm²), FF_Q, HU_Q for SIM2
Tmax, Tmin (°C), RR (mm), ETP (mm), Rg (MJ/m²), FF (m/s), HU (%)

param.name: drias_zip
param.label: ZIP archive of DRIAS-2020 NetCDF files
param.help: One NetCDF file per variable, recognised by its name: *tasmax*.nc, *tasmin*.nc, *huss*.nc, *sfcWind*.nc, *rsds*.nc, *prtot*.nc, *evspsblpot*.nc.

param.name: input_files
param.label: AgroClim daily station files
param.help: One or several Station_Agroclim_INRAE_{station}_daily_{first year}_{last year}.csv files from the Recherche Data Gouv dataset doi:10.57745/BQ0BWB. The station_id column gives the name of the STICS files.

param.name: input_file
param.label: Daily climate table
param.help: Comma, semicolon, tab or pipe separated, with a header line and one row per site and day. Lines starting with '#' are skipped.

expand.name: col_date
expand.label: Date column
expand.absent_help: Dates such as 2020-01-31, or YYYYMMDD integers.

expand.name: col_etp
expand.label: Potential evapotranspiration column
expand.absent_help: If not selected, ETP is written as -999.9 (missing).

expand.name: col_wind
expand.label: Wind speed column
expand.absent_help: If not selected, wind is written as -999.9 (missing).

expand.name: col_hr
expand.label: Mean relative humidity column (%)
expand.absent_help: Used to compute the vapour pressure when no vapour pressure column is selected.

expand.name: col_vapp
expand.label: Vapour pressure column (hPa)
expand.absent_help: If neither this column nor relative humidity is selected, vapour pressure is written as -999.9 (missing).

param.name: unit_wind
param.label: Wind speed unit and measurement height
param.help: Speeds measured at 10 m are multiplied by the correction factor below.

has_text.text: daily values averaged over each cell

tool.help:
.. class:: infomark
**What it does**
Converts daily weather data into the input files of the **STICS** crop model. Variables are renamed and converted to STICS units, missing variables are derived (mean temperature, vapour pressure, wind speed), the annual atmospheric CO2 concentration is added, and the result is split into one file per cell (or station) and per year.
-----
**Supported sources**
+----------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+ | Source | Input | Cell / station ID | +================+===========================================================+=========================================+ | ERA5 | Open-Meteo daily table (ERA5 Daily Extractor output), or | selected column (table), shapefile or | | | daily NetCDF grid from the Copernicus Climate Data Store | one cell per pixel (NetCDF) | +----------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+ | SAFRAN | GeoSAS export, Météo-France SIM2 file (detected from its | selected column (table), shapefile or | | | column names) or NetCDF grid | one cell per pixel (NetCDF) | +----------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+ | DRIAS-2020 | ZIP archive with one NetCDF file per variable | shapefile (required) | +----------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+ | AgroClim | INRAE station daily files from Recherche Data Gouv | ``station_id`` column of the files | | | (doi:10.57745/BQ0BWB), one or several stations | | +----------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+ | Custom | any daily table: columns and units are selected in the | selected column | | | form | | +----------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
**Unit conversions applied**
- ERA5 NetCDF: temperatures K → °C, ``ssrd`` J/m² → MJ/m², ``tp`` m → mm, ``pev`` absolute value m → mm, wind from ``si10`` or √(u10² + v10²), vapour pressure from the dew point ``d2m``. - Open-Meteo: already in STICS units, except wind (km/h → m/s). - SAFRAN (GeoSAS): none. SIM2: ``SSI_Q`` J/cm² → MJ/m², precipitation = ``PRELIQ_Q`` + ``PRENEI_Q``. - DRIAS-2020: K → °C, W/m² → MJ/m², kg/m²/s → mm, specific humidity → relative humidity → vapour pressure. - AgroClim: ``tx``, ``tn`` (°C), ``rg`` J/cm² → MJ/m², ``rr`` (mm), ``etpp`` (Penman ETP, mm), ``v`` (m/s), ``um`` (%) → vapour pressure. - Vapour pressure from relative humidity uses the mean temperature (Tmax + Tmin) / 2.
**Wind height**: STICS expects wind speed at 2 m. Speeds measured at 10 m (ERA5, Open-Meteo, SAFRAN, DRIAS) are multiplied by the *wind height correction factor* (0.7 by default). AgroClim INRAE stations measure wind at 2 m, so no correction is applied to them.
**Gridded data and shapefile**: the shapefile polygons need an integer ``cell`` column. The grid pixels whose centre falls in a polygon belong to that cell and their daily values are averaged. Pixels outside every polygon are dropped. Without a shapefile (ERA5 and SAFRAN NetCDF only), each pixel becomes its own cell, numbered 0..N-1 in row-major order.
-----
**Output**
A ZIP archive ``stics_output/{cell}/{cell}.{year}``: one headerless file per cell and per year, ready to be used as a JavaSTICS / SticsRFiles weather file. Columns are separated by spaces and right-aligned, as in the weather files shipped with JavaSTICS. The 13 columns are:
cell ID, year, month, day of month, day of year, Tmin (°C), Tmax (°C), global radiation (MJ/m²/day), ETP (mm/day), precipitation (mm/day), wind at 2 m (m/s), vapour pressure (hPa), CO2 (ppm).
Missing values, and variables that the source does not provide, are written as **-999.9**, the STICS missing-value code.
A processing log lists the variables found, the conversions applied, the numbering of non-integer site IDs and the number of missing values.
**CO2**: annual means from Mauna Loa (NOAA/GML, downloaded at run time) from 1959 onward, and an ice-core record (Etheridge et al. 1996) for earlier years. Without network access, a bundled copy of the Mauna Loa series (1959-2023) is used; years after the last available year get no CO2 value (-999.9).
-----
**Limitations**
- Input data must be daily. - In a table, each site must have one row per day. A file with several sites needs a cell / site ID column, otherwise the tool stops with an error. - Tables may not be combined with a shapefile: their sites are identified by a column.
